# tokplan

> Will the model fit, how fast will it run, how many GPUs, what will it cost: a first-order inference planner for any Hugging Face model on any GPU, in pure Python with no dependencies.

## Prompt

- [Prompt for coding agents](https://vitalops.ai/tokplan/agent-prompt.txt): install, the API, the command line, what it is and is not

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://vitalops.ai/tokplan/docs/content/introduction.md): What tokplan does and does not do
- [Install](https://vitalops.ai/tokplan/docs/content/install.md): pip, the one-file build, checking it works
- [Command line](https://vitalops.ai/tokplan/docs/content/cli.md): every flag, the report line by line, exit codes, JSON output, the Hub
- [Python API](https://vitalops.ai/tokplan/docs/content/python-api.md): plan, fit, perf, the Plan, Layout, Perf and Scenario dataclasses, the catalogues

## What goes in

- [Models](https://vitalops.ai/tokplan/docs/content/models.md): the built-in catalogue, the Hub loader, mixtures of experts, latent attention, caveats
- [GPUs](https://vitalops.ai/tokplan/docs/content/gpus.md): the hardware catalogue, how each figure is used, hardware not in it

## How it works

- [The physics](https://vitalops.ai/tokplan/docs/content/physics.md): every formula and constant, what is not modelled, calibrating against a measurement
- [The interactive planner](https://vitalops.ai/tokplan/docs/content/ui.md): tokplan ui and the web page, the same physics in JavaScript
- [Contributing](https://vitalops.ai/tokplan/docs/content/contributing.md): layout, tests, adding a GPU or a model, the one-file build

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/vitalops/tokplan)
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/tokplan/)
